chunks: From him, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Jabalah, from Dharih al-Muharibi, from Abi ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

Some people asked Aba ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام while I was present, and he said: “When the sun declines, then it is a time from which nothing holds you back except your supererogatory prayer, whether you lengthen it or shorten it.”
Then some of the people said: “We perform the first prayer when it reaches two feet, and the ʿAsr prayer at four feet.” So Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام said: “Half of that is more beloved to me.”

key_terms.النِّصْفُ: half of the mentioned measure, indicating a more preferred earlier time
key_terms.زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ: the sun declined from the meridian, marking the beginning of the noon prayer time
key_terms.سُبْحَتُكَ: your supererogatory prayer performed in addition to the obligatory prayer
key_terms.وَقْتٌ: the appointed time for performing the prayer

ai.seo_question: When does the time for Zuhr and ʿAsr begin according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith discusses the time of salat after the sun’s decline and indicates that one may begin after zawal, with only the supererogatory prayer delaying him. It also reports a preferred earlier performance of the prayers, as Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that half of the mentioned interval is more beloved to him.
